content.value_statement: Long AI sessions can waste tokens, slow responses, and lose important context. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical patterns for compacting, masking, caching, and budgeting context.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to compact, mask, partition, or preserve context during long AI workflows.
Provides threshold guidance for token budgets and compaction triggers.
Shows observation masking patterns that replace verbose tool output with retrievable references.
Documents cache-friendly prompt ordering for stable prefixes and reusable templates.
Includes local Python utilities for token estimation, summarization, masking, and budget tracking.
Describes how to split large tasks across focused sub-agents.
limitations: Token estimation uses simple heuristics and should be replaced with model-specific tokenizers.
Summarization examples are illustrative and do not guarantee production quality.
The skill does not connect to live model telemetry or provider billing systems.
Users must still decide which context is safe to summarize or mask.

use_cases.title: Reduce Long-Session Token Use
use_cases.description: Plan compaction thresholds and summarize older context while preserving current task state and decisions.

use_cases.title: Design Agent Memory Flows
use_cases.description: Mask verbose tool outputs behind references so agents can keep useful summaries without carrying full logs.

use_cases.title: Improve Cache Efficiency
use_cases.description: Order stable prompts, tool definitions, and templates before variable content to improve prefix cache reuse.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a long session or prompt.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this conversation or prompt for context waste. Identify what to keep, summarize, mask, or remove, and explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Token Budget
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a context budget for this workflow. Allocate tokens across system prompt, tools, retrieved documents, history, outputs, and reserved buffer.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Compaction Rules
prompt_templates.scenario: Building rules for a long-running agent.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design compaction and observation masking rules for this agent. Include trigger thresholds, preservation rules, and retrieval behavior for masked outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Production Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a scaled agent architecture.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this agent architecture for context optimization. Recommend partitioning, cache-stable prompt ordering, telemetry, and quality checks for production use.

output_examples.input: A chat session is near its context limit and contains many old tool outputs.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend preserving current decisions, summarizing earlier discussion, and masking old verbose outputs behind short references.

output_examples.input: An agent workflow repeats the same system prompt and tool definitions across many requests.
output_examples.output: The skill would suggest stable prefix ordering, consistent formatting, and moving variable session details after reusable prompt sections.

output_examples.input: A team wants a plan for context budgets in a production support assistant.
output_examples.output: The skill would produce budget categories, trigger thresholds, reserved capacity, and checks for quality loss after compaction.

best_practices: Measure token usage before changing context strategy.
Preserve active task state, decisions, and user preferences during compaction.
Keep stable prompt sections first to improve cache reuse.
anti_patterns: Masking recent or critical observations that the agent still needs.
Adding timestamps or session-specific text before stable prompt content.
Compressing context without checking whether output quality changed.

faq.question: Does this skill increase a model context window?
faq.answer: No. It helps use the available window more efficiently through compaction, masking, partitioning, and cache-aware prompt design.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is tool-agnostic and the metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support.

faq.question: Does it make network requests?
faq.answer: No evidence found. Reviewed files contain documentation and local Python utilities, not network calls.

faq.question: Are the Python utilities production ready?
faq.answer: They are reference utilities. Production systems should add model-specific tokenizers, stronger evaluation, and operational telemetry.

faq.question: When should I compact context?
faq.answer: The skill recommends warning near 70 percent usage and triggering compaction near 80 percent, adjusted for task quality.

faq.question: What should never be compacted?
faq.answer: Do not compact system prompts, active task state, recent observations, key decisions, or important user preferences.
